ShowSubtitleRow.comment: Controls the Row 2 subtitle line under each dialog tab's title.

BrightnessSteps.comment: Number of brightness buckets the ambient GUI tint snaps to.

HueSteps.comment: Number of hue buckets (per channel) the ambient GUI tint snaps to.

TintStrength.comment: How much of the ambient light's hue skew is kept (0 = neutral, 1 = full skew).

SmoothingTau.comment: Exponential smoothing time-constant for the ambient GUI tint transition.

DetectionRadius.comment: How close the player must be to an Inbox-capable block for the unseen-assignment particle effect to consider spawning.

RainbowRatio.comment: Fraction of each tick's spawned motes that get a randomized full-range hue instead of the base amber band.

CountMultiplier.comment: Scales the base per-tick mote count.

SeedBurstMultiplier.comment: One-time multiplier applied on the tick the particle trigger first turns true, so the field looks already-established.
